action.content: Write an academic proposal to a customer who's interested in implementing a new feature for their product. Put double quotes around your entire response.
action.label: context

action.content:
"Dear Customer,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to express my strong interest in implementing a new feature for your product. This feature, which I believe will significantly enhance your user experience and add value to your offerings, has been thoroughly researched and developed.

The proposed feature addresses a key area of improvement in your current product, specifically focusing on [describe the area, e.g., user interface, performance, security]. By integrating this feature, we can expect to see measurable benefits, including [mention specific benefits, e.g., increased efficiency, improved user satisfaction, enhanced security].

I have prepared a detailed proposal outlining the implementation plan, including the timeline, resources required, and potential risks. I am confident that this feature will be a valuable addition to your product and will help you stay ahead of the competition.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss this further and answer any questions you may have. Please let me know if you are available for a meeting at your earliest convenience.

Thank you for considering this proposal. I look forward to the possibility of working together to bring this feature to life.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
action.label: response
